The full series of Walkure no Hokyuuhei. There are still two remaining titles from Hirasaka Fuyu's tankoubon: Lilith no Rokkotsu and Aru Hitobashira no Kioku (which I'm going to translate both chapters from scratch). I'm going to take some time working on other artist's work.

Working on Walkure no Hokyuuhei is pretty tiring, moreover that this is a non-commission. The story and characters feel half-baked and it could evolve into something more, but the author decided to slam the brake. Despite that, I genuinely think that the art, the entire tankoubon's art, is amazing and it deserves to be seen and experienced by more people. I'll take my time completing the translation.
